PagerDuty: page fired for alert: "high-kv-cache-miss-rate (prod)" — severity: P2 — triggered by 5m window crossing threshold (90%). link: https://pagerduty.example/incident/INC12345
incident-bot: Automated page posted to #eng-oncall — incident INC12345 — escalation policy: oncall-sre -> platform -> eng-runtime
Kat (SRE): acked — taking it. I'll dig into kv cache metrics first.
Kat (SRE): grafana: https://grafana.example/d/abcd/kv-cache?orgId=1&var-env=prod — seeing a short spike at 12:03:14 UTC, ~3x baseline.
Kat (SRE): logs look like a burst of cache misses from a single customer subnet, likely warmup:
```
2026-03-14T12:03:10Z INFO kv:get miss key=customer-789 shard=4
2026-03-14T12:03:11Z WARN kv:writeback throttle=0.8
2026-03-14T12:03:12Z INFO request:from=10.23.45.0/24 requests=240
```
Mike (Platform Oncall): @Kat could be autoscaler/rollout noise — any deploys at ~12:00?
Lee (Eng Runtime): saw a small canary rollout on region-us-west at 11:58, but rollout was marked success. No long-running errors.
Kat (SRE): not seeing error traces, just sustained miss-rate spike for ~90s and then drop. No latency SLO breaches.
Ana (Support): customer-facing checks: no elevated 5xx or support tickets in the window. pinging CS to confirm.
Kat (SRE): temporarily silencing the PD alert for 10m to stop flapping while we confirm. `/pd silence INC12345 10m`
incident-bot: Alert INC12345 silenced for 10 minutes by Kat (SRE).
PagerDuty: incident INC12345 auto-resolved (condition cleared) — resolution: metric returned below threshold
Kat (SRE): auto-resolve — looks like a transient kv warmup spike from a client batch sync. No customer-visible impact.
Mike (Platform Oncall): leaving a short follow-up: raise the alert window from 5m to 10m and add a minimum sample count to avoid single-subnet bursts causing pages. Proposed rule snippet:
```
- alert: HighKVCacheMissRate
  expr: sum(rate(kv_miss_total[5m])) by (job) / sum(rate(kv_requests_total[5m])) by (job) > 0.9
  for: 5m
  annotations:
    runbook: https://wiki.redwood/example-kv-warmup
```
=> change `for: 5m` -> `for: 10m` and require `kv_requests_total > 100`
Lee (Eng Runtime): agree. I'll open a small PR to bump the window and add min_samples.
Kat (SRE): creating post-incident note in #postmortems with links to grafana and the short log excerpt. No customer impact, marking as brief-flap autoclosed.
Ana (Support): CS confirmed no tickets, will monitor for any delayed reports.
Mike (Platform Oncall): thanks everyone — nice quick triage. :thumbsup:
Kat (SRE): adding `needs-followup` label for alert tuning.
incident-bot: Thread closed for INC12345 (auto-resolved).
__notes: This thread documents a transient PagerDuty page caused by a kv cache miss spike and the live mitigation (silence, investigation, tuning follow-up).
